rationale: Multiple structural and stylistic issues: (1) two sections titled 'Why this matters' — duplicates the banned 'matters' framing AND repeats a thesis; (2) buzzword density extreme (leverage, cutting-edge, elevate, load-bearing, facilitate, robust, empowered, state-of-the-art, solution, seamless, ecosystem, synergize, holistic, paradigm shift, turnkey — 15+ hits); (3) N-reasons-one-solution framing explicit ('three issues, one solution'); (4) cut-on-sight phrases (In today's fast-paced, Let me explain, Stay tuned, exclamation points, Why this matters); (5) unsourced metric ('around 40% improvement'); (6) restated thesis (Why this matters appears twice).
